mind.text: My foundation. Grids, type and composition still shape how I structure every idea, from a campaign to a landing page.

mind.q: Why things work and what they should achieve.
mind.text: Marketing taught me to ask what a visual is for before deciding what it looks like — positioning, objectives, channels.
UX/UI made me design for real behaviour, and teaching made me explain ideas so others can use them.

mind.q: How ideas connect to meaningful objectives.
mind.text: E-commerce and building CodaStudio grounded my creativity in operations, budgets, clients and results.

timeline.d: Graduated in Graphic Advertising / Graphic Design, with a final-year project focused on UX/UI Design. Worked as a graphic designer in a printing company and gained UX/UI and social media design experience through a marketing agency internship.

Lead Graphic Designer at a large printing company, supervising a junior designer. Pursued master’s-level studies in Theories of Creativity, and gained experience through an internship with a marketing company in Saudi Arabia.
Developed freelance experience across creative and marketing-related projects.
A year on an e-commerce project, combining marketing, design, project management, and commercial operations.
Continued freelance work and trained more than 50 people in digital marketing.
Established CodaStudio and expanded into independent creative and strategic client projects.

method.d: Understand the people, problem, brand, and business.
Connect insights, ideas, opportunities, and objectives.
Translate strategy into experiences, campaigns, content, and design.
Learn from performance, feedback, and experimentation.
